objective: Create a second self-contained independent work that tests narrative space, session-scoped memory, and optional sound without coupling to Mirror Cartographer or external services.
selection_basis: I-001 was already completed_preview_ready. No newer canonical independent_creative_web item existed in ACTIVE_QUEUE.json, so this additive record advances the independent studio without overwriting another team's queue state.
completed_slices: Implemented The Fourth Room as a single-file narrative web environment with authored interaction states.
Added opt-in Web Audio, session-only visit memory, reduced-motion behavior, keyboard semantics, live status, safe-area layout, and bounded canvas rendering.
Added static contract tests for independence, accessibility, network isolation, non-autoplay audio, and ephemeral storage.
Extended the independent identity notes with explicit provenance and creative-grammar boundaries.
Detected and corrected a double-animation-loop defect during source fetch-back.
Retained source-level verification evidence without claiming runtime execution, browser rendering, hosting, or deployment.
acceptance_remaining: Run node --test independent/fourth-room/contract.test.cjs in an authenticated checkout.
Render in desktop and mobile browsers and inspect keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, viewport, session reset, and opt-in audio behavior.
Capture an accessibility-tree inspection and a representative mobile performance trace.
Publish only to an isolated independent preview after hosting provenance and rollback are verified.
safe_next_action: Execute the committed contract tests and a browser-level interaction harness for both independent works, then produce a small independent index only after each work has verified preview evidence.
